questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence using reported speech.
He said, 'I am going to the cinema.'
options: He said he was going to the cinema.
He said he goes to the cinema.
He said he is going to the cinema.
He said he will go to the cinema.
questions.answer: He said he was going to the cinema.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement?
She said, 'I have finished my homework.'
options: She said she has finished her homework.
She said she had finished her homework.
She said she finishes her homework.
She said she will finish her homework.
questions.answer: She said she had finished her homework.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported form.
He said, 'I would like some coffee.'
options: He said he would like some coffee.
He said he would have liked some coffee.
He said he likes some coffee.
He said he had liked some coffee.
questions.answer: He said he would like some coffee.

questions.question:
Which option correctly reports the question?
What time do you leave for the airport?
options: She asked what time I leave for the airport.
She asked what time did I leave for the airport.
She asked what time do I leave for the airport.
She asked what time would I leave for the airport.
questions.answer: She asked what time I leave for the airport.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported speech sentence.
He said, 'If I had more time, I would help you.'
options: He said if he had more time, he would help me.
He said if he had more time, he would have helped me.
He said if he had more time, he helps me.
He said if he had more time, he had helped me.
questions.answer: He said if he had more time, he would help me.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice?
This book was written by a famous author in 1999.
options: This book was written by a famous author in 1999.
This book were written by a famous author in 1999.
This book is written by a famous author in 1999.
This book has written by a famous author in 1999.
questions.answer: This book was written by a famous author in 1999.

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form.
English ________ widely spoken in China now.
options: is being spoken
is spoken
is speaking
is spoken by

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a conditional structure?
If it ________ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
options: rains
will rain
rained
were to rain

questions.question:
Choose the correct discourse marker to complete the sentence.
______ I'm usually quite busy, I try to help out with the project.
options: Although
However
Therefore
In addition

questions.question:
Which collocation is correct?
She has a ________ for solving complex problems.
options: talent
gift
ability
skill
